column1: # Cells of the frozen wgsnFaints.csv that are not what their column says,
# set right before the parse reads them. One row per cell: `wgsn_id` keys the
# row, `column` names the CSV column, `value` replaces the cell (empty = the
# file states no value), `evidence` says why. A row keying no faints row, or
# restating the cell's current value, fails build:wgsn.
